verdict.rationale: Muse's own docs describe an agent with its own computer/file system/terminal that writes and runs code, builds custom tools and dashboards ('build a tracker for your spending... a dashboard to find patterns in your sleep'), and stores all generated files in a VM that users can inspect, edit and download freely. This directly covers code execution on data, computed outputs, and downloadable files. missing for 10: explicit mention of chart/visualization rendering, and independent/hands-on verification of code-execution quality beyond vendor claims.
